description: This file implements message output handling including console, syslog, file, JSON formatting, and UDP transmission for the RDK Management project, specifically within the WPEFramework Publishers namespace.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Provides conversion of metadata to formatted string output, supporting abbreviated and full formats.

classes.name: SyslogOutput
classes.description: Outputs messages to syslog or console on Windows.

classes.name: FileOutput
classes.description: Outputs messages to a file if the file is open.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: Converts message metadata into JSON format with configurable output options.

classes.name: UDPOutput
classes.description: Handles sending messages over UDP, including nested Channel class for datagram management.

classes.name: UDPOutput::Channel
classes.description: Manages individual UDP datagram channels for sending data.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts metadata into a formatted string based on the abbreviated flag.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Outputs a message via the respective output method (console, syslog, file, UDP).

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts message metadata into JSON format with optional fields based on output options.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data over UDP channel, returning the number of bytes sent.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Prepares and triggers UDP message transmission.
